items.statement: Establish and follow written warehousing procedures for drug products that cover quarantine before release and storage under appropriate conditions.
items.quote: Written procedures describing the warehousing of drug products shall be established and followed. They shall include:

items.statement: Written warehousing procedures for drug products cover holding drug products in quarantine until the quality control unit releases them.
items.quote: Quarantine of drug products before release by the quality control unit.

items.statement: Written warehousing procedures for drug products cover storing drug products under suitable temperature, humidity and light conditions so their identity, strength, quality and purity are not affected.
items.quote: Storage of drug products under appropriate conditions of temperature, humidity, and light so that the identity, strength, quality, and purity of the drug products are not affected.

items.statement: Establish and follow written procedures for the distribution of drug products that cover first-out distribution of the oldest approved stock and lot traceability for recall.
items.quote: Written procedures shall be established, and followed, describing the distribution of drug products. They shall include:

items.statement: Written distribution procedures for drug products include a procedure so that the oldest approved stock of a drug product is shipped first; departing from this is allowed only if the departure is temporary and appropriate.
items.quote: A procedure whereby the oldest approved stock of a drug product is distributed first. Deviation from this requirement is permitted if such deviation is temporary and appropriate.
items.condition: deviation only if temporary and appropriate

items.statement: Written distribution procedures for drug products include a system that allows the distribution of each drug product lot to be readily determined, to facilitate recall if necessary.
items.quote: A system by which the distribution of each lot of drug product can be readily determined to facilitate its recall if necessary.

items.statement: Have the appropriate organizational unit draft any laboratory specifications, standards, sampling plans, test procedures or other laboratory control mechanisms, and any change to them, and have the quality control unit review and approve them.
items.quote: The establishment of any specifications, standards, sampling plans, test procedures, or other laboratory control mechanisms required by this subpart, including any change in such specifications, standards, sampling plans, test procedures, or other laboratory control mechanisms, shall be drafted by the appropriate organizational unit and reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.

items.statement: Follow the laboratory control requirements and document them at the time they are performed.
items.quote: The requirements in this subpart shall be followed and shall be documented at the time of performance.

items.statement: Record and justify any deviation from the written laboratory specifications, standards, sampling plans, test procedures or other laboratory control mechanisms.
items.quote: Any deviation from the written specifications, standards, sampling plans, test procedures, or other laboratory control mechanisms shall be recorded and justified.

items.statement: Laboratory controls establish scientifically sound and appropriate specifications, standards, sampling plans and test procedures designed to assure that components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, labeling and drug products conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.
items.quote: Laboratory controls shall include the establishment of scientifically sound and appropriate specifications, standards, sampling plans, and test procedures designed to assure that components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, labeling, and drug products conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality, and purity.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, determine conformity to the applicable written acceptance specifications for each lot within each shipment of components, drug product containers, closures and labeling used in manufacturing, processing, packing or holding drug products.
items.quote: Determination of conformity to applicable written specifications for the acceptance of each lot within each shipment of components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of drug products.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, make sure the acceptance specifications for components, drug product containers, closures and labeling describe the sampling and testing procedures used.
items.quote: The specifications shall include a description of the sampling and testing procedures used.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, make sure samples of components, drug product containers, closures and labeling are representative and adequately identified.
items.quote: Samples shall be representative and adequately identified.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, make sure the procedures require appropriate retesting of any component, drug product container or closure that is subject to deterioration.
items.quote: Such procedures shall also require appropriate retesting of any component, drug product container, or closure that is subject to deterioration.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, determine conformance of in-process materials to written specifications and describe the sampling and testing procedures for them.
items.quote: Determination of conformance to written specifications and a description of sampling and testing procedures for in-process materials.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, make sure in-process material samples are representative and properly identified.
items.quote: Such samples shall be representative and properly identified.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, determine conformance of drug products to written descriptions of sampling procedures and appropriate specifications.
items.quote: Determination of conformance to written descriptions of sampling procedures and appropriate specifications for drug products.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, make sure drug product samples are representative and properly identified.
items.quote: Such samples shall be representative and properly identified.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, calibrate instruments, apparatus, gauges and recording devices at suitable intervals under an established written program that contains specific directions, schedules, limits for accuracy and precision, and provisions for remedial action if accuracy or precision limits are not met.
items.quote: The calibration of instruments, apparatus, gauges, and recording devices at suitable intervals in accordance with an established written program containing specific directions, schedules, limits for accuracy and precision, and provisions for remedial action in the event accuracy and/or precision limits are not met.

items.statement: As part of laboratory controls, do not use instruments, apparatus, gauges or recording devices that do not meet established specifications.
items.quote: Instruments, apparatus, gauges, and recording devices not meeting established specifications shall not be used.

items.statement: Before release, carry out appropriate laboratory determination for each drug product batch that it satisfactorily conforms to final specifications, including the identity and strength of each active ingredient.
items.quote: For each batch of drug product, there shall be appropriate laboratory determination of satisfactory conformance to final specifications for the drug product, including the identity and strength of each active ingredient, prior to release.

items.statement: Where sterility and/or pyrogen testing is done on specific batches of short-lived radiopharmaceuticals, those batches may be released before that testing is finished, provided the testing is completed as soon as possible.
items.quote: Where sterility and/or pyrogen testing are conducted on specific batches of shortlived radiopharmaceuticals, such batches may be released prior to completion of sterility and/or pyrogen testing, provided such testing is completed as soon as possible.
items.condition: short-lived radiopharmaceuticals; testing completed as soon as possible

items.statement: Carry out appropriate laboratory testing, as necessary, of each batch of drug product that must be free of objectionable microorganisms.
items.quote: There shall be appropriate laboratory testing, as necessary, of each batch of drug product required to be free of objectionable microorganisms.
items.condition: product required to be free of objectionable microorganisms

items.statement: Describe any sampling and testing plans in written procedures that state the sampling method and the number of units per batch to be tested.
items.quote: Any sampling and testing plans shall be described in written procedures that shall include the method of sampling and the number of units per batch to be tested

items.statement: Follow the written sampling and testing procedures.
items.quote: such written procedure shall be followed.

items.statement: Set acceptance criteria for quality control unit sampling and testing that are adequate to assure batches meet each appropriate specification and appropriate statistical quality control criteria as a condition of approval and release.
items.quote: Acceptance criteria for the sampling and testing conducted by the quality control unit shall be adequate to assure that batches of drug products meet each appropriate specification and appropriate statistical quality control criteria as a condition for their approval and release.

items.statement: Include appropriate acceptance levels and/or appropriate rejection levels in the statistical quality control criteria.
items.quote: The statistical quality control criteria shall include appropriate acceptance levels and/or appropriate rejection levels.

items.statement: Establish and document the accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and reproducibility of the test methods the firm uses.
items.quote: The accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility of test methods employed by the firm shall be established and documented.

items.statement: Test method validation and documentation may be done through the laboratory records that document each test method used.
items.quote: Such validation and documentation may be accomplished in accordance with § 211.194(a)(2).

items.statement: Reject drug products that fail to meet established standards or specifications and any other relevant quality control criteria.
items.quote: Drug products failing to meet established standards or specifications and any other relevant quality control criteria shall be rejected.
items.condition: product fails standards, specifications or QC criteria

items.statement: Rejected drug products may be reprocessed.
items.quote: Reprocessing may be performed.

items.statement: Make sure reprocessed material meets appropriate standards, specifications and any other relevant criteria before it is accepted and used.
items.quote: Prior to acceptance and use, reprocessed material must meet appropriate standards, specifications, and any other relevant criteria.

items.statement: Have a written testing program designed to assess the stability characteristics of drug products.
items.quote: There shall be a written testing program designed to assess the stability characteristics of drug products.

items.statement: Use the stability testing results to determine appropriate storage conditions and expiration dates.
items.quote: The results of such stability testing shall be used in determining appropriate storage conditions and expiration dates.

items.statement: Follow the written stability testing program, and make it cover sample size and test intervals, sample storage conditions, test methods, testing in the marketed container-closure system, and testing of products for reconstitution.
items.quote: The written program shall be followed and shall include:

items.statement: The written stability testing program includes sample size and test intervals based on statistical criteria for each attribute examined, to assure valid estimates of stability.
items.quote: Sample size and test intervals based on statistical criteria for each attribute examined to assure valid estimates of stability;

items.statement: The written stability testing program includes storage conditions for the samples retained for testing.
items.quote: Storage conditions for samples retained for testing;

items.statement: The written stability testing program includes reliable, meaningful and specific test methods.
items.quote: Reliable, meaningful, and specific test methods;

items.statement: The written stability testing program includes testing of the drug product in the same container-closure system in which it is marketed.
items.quote: Testing of the drug product in the same container-closure system as that in which the drug product is marketed;

items.statement: The written stability testing program includes testing of drug products for reconstitution at the time of dispensing (as directed in the labeling) and also after reconstitution.
items.quote: Testing of drug products for reconstitution at the time of dispensing (as directed in the labeling) as well as after they are reconstituted.

items.statement: Test an adequate number of batches of each drug product to determine an appropriate expiration date.
items.quote: An adequate number of batches of each drug product shall be tested to determine an appropriate expiration date

items.statement: Maintain a record of the stability data used to determine the expiration date.
items.quote: a record of such data shall be maintained.

items.statement: Where full shelf life studies are not available and are being conducted, accelerated studies combined with basic stability information on the components, drug products and container-closure system may be used to support tentative expiration dates.
items.quote: Accelerated studies, combined with basic stability information on the components, drug products, and container-closure system, may be used to support tentative expiration dates provided full shelf life studies are not available and are being conducted.
items.condition: full shelf life studies not available and being conducted

items.statement: Where accelerated study data are used to project a tentative expiration date beyond the date supported by actual shelf life studies, conduct stability studies, including drug product testing at appropriate intervals, until the tentative expiration date is verified or the appropriate expiration date is determined.
items.quote: Where data from accelerated studies are used to project a tentative expiration date that is beyond a date supported by actual shelf life studies, there must be stability studies conducted, including drug product testing at appropriate intervals, until the tentative expiration date is verified or the appropriate expiration date determined.
items.condition: tentative expiry beyond actual shelf life data

items.statement: For homeopathic drug products, have a written stability assessment based at least on testing or examination of the drug product for ingredient compatibility and on marketing experience with the product, showing no degradation of the product over its normal or expected period of use.
items.quote: There shall be a written assessment of stability based at least on testing or examination of the drug product for compatibility of the ingredients, and based on marketing experience with the drug product to indicate that there is no degradation of the product for the normal or expected period of use.

items.statement: For homeopathic drug products, base the stability evaluation on the same container-closure system in which the product is marketed.
items.quote: Evaluation of stability shall be based on the same container-closure system in which the drug product is being marketed.

not_applicable.text: For homeopathic drug products, the requirements of this section are as follows:
Allergenic extracts that are labeled “No U.S. Standard of Potency” are exempt from the requirements of this section.
